text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her characteristic running style showcased in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) seemed to have sparked quite a buzz...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Media exposure was increasing
more than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—We understand your next goal is conquering the 'Arima Kinen'...
Could you share your enthusiasm for it?”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Tailoring training to a tricky course
is a given, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm searching for what I'm lacking,
whether it be mentally or physically!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see, what's missing, is it...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
In this Arima Kinen, with so many rivals from the same generation like Manhattan Cafe,
to advance and claim victory―

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...Agnes Tachyon-san?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Rivals," huh...?
I see, you've got a point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she dropped those profound words,
she never explained what they meant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff, pant*...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, running these back-to-back is brutal!
My legs are getting heavier and heavier.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, if it isn't Cafe!
Do you need something?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be you're volunteering
as a test subject for the new drug I developed yesterday—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, it's not.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well then, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe opened her mouth as if having made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Would you run with me?
...I just have to surpass the you of right now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Beneath the blue sky, the sound of the gates opening rings out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon and Manhattan Cafe
both leaped onto the turf at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon is about a length behind, but...
both seem to be sizing each other up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Rounding the fourth corner just like that,
they spill into the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Heh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon suddenly accelerated.
Manhattan Cafe followed right after.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haa! Haa! Haa!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh. It won't let go at all.
What insane tenacity... What do I do...?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(...'What should I do'...?
I've never cared about a rival before—)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
I want to catch up to "you"...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
K-Kekekeke!
Kuhahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea that watching passion blaze right next to me
could be this thrilling! I never realized it until now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: After all, up until now, the only thing that ever interested me was exploring the unknown...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon's eyes flashed with a sharp glint.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder why!
I just really don't want to yield victory to you—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final straight, a mere 200 meters.
Neither side yielding an inch in this duel—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The one who conquered it all was Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no mind to Manhattan Cafe catching her breath,
Agnes Tachyon was lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm. That race just now was exceedingly intriguing.
This calls for an immediate self-analysis.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Has my perspective broadened a bit too...?
No, it could just be because it's Cafe...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(—Wait, why did I just think,
"Because it's Cafe"...?)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you very much.
...Even though I couldn't win today...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Still... in the Arima Kinen. Surely.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Wait a moment.
Why are you showing such hostility towards me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hostility, or rather... heh,
no, more like "rivals."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“...That might be true.
...Even to me, it sounds hard to believe, though.”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...During the Tenno Sho (Autumn), you reminded me a little of that girl."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So... I thought that if I can defeat the current you,
I'll surely be able to catch up to her, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon gazes intently
at Manhattan Cafe as she stammers through her words.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
What... is it...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm... 'that girl'?
Isn't 'that girl' your imaginary friend?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Emotional and blindly faithful in every way!
Even if that state is just the result of brain chemistry,
your peculiarity is that of a genius!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, it makes me feel the possibility of the mystical!
As if it's worthy of being part of the many phenomena science has yet to fully explain!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I really must insist you let me dissect that brain of yours just onc—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just then, as if realizing something,
her tone suddenly faltered.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see.
So that is why you are "special" to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I knew that for a long time, she viewed
Manhattan Cafe as something unusual,
yet regarded her favorably all the same.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How to put it... I feel like you possess
every single quality that I could never have.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I even think it might be interesting
to try living like you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —In other words, you could very well be the final piece that pushes me toward my ultimate goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She, who was always absorbed solely in her research,
now recognizes someone as "special."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... There's no mistaking it.
I have everything I was missing now.
Thank you, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Well, in other words, from here on, we will push each other to transcend being mere "rivals."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"And that she's looking forward to facing you in the Arima Kinen.
That's what she meant."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Manhattan Cafe's bewilderment soon turned
into determination... and she stared Agnes Tachyon
firmly in the eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —An interview held the next day.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Is there anyone you consider a rival?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that! It just opened yesterday.
It's called Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her...
I'm really looking forward to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The very next day, her answer became a massive headline
and spread across the world.
